import { onMount, useEffect, useMemo, useSignal, useStore } from "@shadow-js/core";
import { useRef } from "react";

export function Todos({ initial }: { initial: string[] }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useSignal(initial);
  const [text, setText] = useStore("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useStore({ done: false });
  const remaining = useMemo(() => items().length);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  onMount(() => {
    input.current?.focus();
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${remaining()} left`;
  });

  const add = () => {
    setItems([...items(), text()]);
    setText("");
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={add}>
      <input ref={input} className="field" value={text()} onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)} />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setFilter({ done: !filter.done })}>
        {filter.done ? "Done" : "Open"}: {remaining()}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}
